question: Does the author's PR796 remove roundoff-generated NaN standard deviations while preserving finite native statistics and downstream mean/std behavior on the declared CPU cases?
owner_decision_scope: A public proposed source change is available for technical review. External owner enrollment, adoption and complete-cost comparison remain separate and unestablished.

source.attribution: v0ropaev owns the report, correction and original regression. Nisayon performs this additional qualification.

environment.hardware: Local macOS ARM64 CPU, no model weights, video decoding, distributed execution, GPU, or physical robot.
environment.imports: Normally import native merger, statistics pipeline and normalization. No module stubs or source-function extraction.

additional_contracts: relative action statistics with two temporal axes
constant-dimension normalization preserves original value when std is zero

confirmation.population: Fresh, constructed mixtures of binary-rational means in [-2,2], standard deviations in {0,0.125,0.25,0.5}, 2 to 4 datasets and positive integer weights 1 to 9. Each case includes a constant and varying dimension; every fourth case uses relative statistics.
confirmation.timing: Do not generate or run until development implementation, native source and criteria are frozen.
confirmation.isolation: Fresh generated conditions, visible to this investigator after generation; not a blinded independent evaluator or an untouched second incident.
confirmation.not_equivalent_to: The existing 32-pair robot-task confirmation obligation is not discharged.

acceptance.must_fix: The exposed constant 1.25 / weights 1:2 witness must fail on base and pass on candidate.
acceptance.preservation: Exact equality of all finite baseline output fields. Each baseline NaN std from the declared finite input must become exactly zero; its corresponding normalized values must follow native zero-std passthrough semantics.
acceptance.finite: All candidate stats and normalized values must be finite on every declared case.
acceptance.controls: A mutant setting every std to zero must be rejected; the original defective native function must not be accepted; an ineffective negative control must return unresolved.
acceptance.mathematical_scope: Use an independent exact-rational mixture moment computation for dyadic positive-variance sanity checks, atol=1e-12, rtol=1e-12. Exposed float32 upstream accumulation errors are reported separately and do not change the frozen NaN-fix criterion.
acceptance.failure_handling: Retain every failed/invalid attempt and every assignment; do not relax tolerances or edit data after results.

nisayon_adapter.use: Reuse existing SDK plan/run/inspect/export/review and required native-call witnesses. Do not alter SDK semantics to make this case pass.
nisayon_adapter.question_boundary: SDK software relation only; deployment decision remains unresolved.

costs.record: Retain acquisition, environment setup, adaptation, native attempts, SDK execution, inspection and review command receipts and outer timers.
costs.competent_baseline: Native tools plus a capable agent with equal information remains the required product comparator. This one investigator's public technical review is not a measured independent agent arm.
costs.reason: Human/provider/prior setup allocation and independent baseline are not yet measured. Raw timings alone cannot establish savings.
costs.double_counting: Child-call time is nested in wrapper time; report inclusive phases without summing nested clocks.

stopping.stop_if: Native import cannot be established within bounded CPU setup, source identity fails, or the four-hour intake cap is reached.

second_incident: Unselected and untouched. Freeze applicable procedure after this case before independent selection; a second seed or current-main source overlay is not that test.
